senses.gloss: (Saf. of נגף) to plague, afflict (corresp. to b. h. עָנָה).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 7:10">B. Mets. VII, 10</cite> (<cite ref="Bava Metzia 93b:18">93ᵇ</cite>) <he>סְגָפָהּ</he> if he maltreated (starved) her (v. <cite ref="O00938"><he>סָכַף</he></cite>).—Part. pass. <cite ref="O00117"><he>סָגוּף</he></cite>; f. <he>סְגוּפָה</he>; pl. <he>סְגוּפִים</he>, <he>סְגוּפִין</he>, <he>סְגוּפוֹת</he> (usu. combined with <he>דָּווּי</he>, v. <cite ref="D00204"><he>דָּוָה</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 24:2">Sifré Deut. 24</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 805:2">Yalk. ib. 805</cite>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 74:17">Gen. R. s. 74</cite>; (<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 74:17">ib.</cite> s. 60 <he>שפופין</he>); a. e.; v. <cite ref="O00938"><he>סָכַף</he></cite> a. <cite ref="O00461"><he>סָחַף</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Taanit 22b:10">Taan. 22ᵇ</cite> <he>לסגֵּף את עצמו בתענית</he> to afflict himself by fasting. Y. Dem. VII, 26ᵇ top <he>לא ירעיב … ולא יְסַגֵּף</he> the hired laborer must not starve himself or undergo privations, because he lessens his employer’s work; a. e.—[<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 27:1">Yalk. Josh. 27</cite> <he>שלא יסגפני</he>, v. <cite ref="U00207"><he>שָׂגַב</he></cite>.]
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 60:11">Gen. R. s. 60</cite> <he>מִסְתַּגֵּף</he> (<he>הוא</he>) he suffers; <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 26">Ex. R. s. 26</cite>; Mekh. B’shall., Vayassa, s. 6; a. e.
